tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List the 20 cities Dim Hour covers, with the city key to pass to the other tools.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: Search Dim Hour's curated restaurant/bar/venue catalog. Pass `city` to search one city, or OMIT `city` to search all ~9,500 venues across every city at once (e.g. 'best ramen anywhere', 'michelin spots'). Returns ranked matches with score (0-100 quality), price tier, neighborhood, happy-hour info, a

tools.name: list_new_venues
tools.description: Venues recently added to the Dim Hour catalog — across all 20 cities or one city. Use for 'what's new on Dim Hour' / new-opening alerts / weekly digests. Dates earlier than 2026-06-06 are estimates reconstructed from history.

tools.name: get_venue
tools.description: Get the full Dim Hour record for one venue: description, signature dishes, address, hours, phone, happy hour, reservation platform, awards, website, Instagram, and (for Iconic 50 venues) the long-form story.

tools.name: list_curated
tools.description: Dim Hour's hand-curated themed lists for a city (e.g. 'Unmarked Doors' speakeasies). Without list_id: returns all list titles. With list_id: returns that list's venues with editorial notes.

tools.name: save_venue
tools.description: Save a venue to the user's Dim Hour account: 'fav' (Favorites), 'want' (Want to try), or 'visited' (Been there). Requires the user's Dim Hour API key (generated in the app: Profile → Concierge API key). The save appears in the app after its next sync (app open or sign-in).

tools.name: add_to_trip
tools.description: Add a venue to one of the user's Dim Hour trips (creates the trip if needed). Identify the trip by trip_code (from list_my_trips) or trip_name; with neither, a new trip is created for the venue's city. Requires the user's Dim Hour API key. Returns the trip's public share link (dimhour.com/trip.html?

tools.name: list_my_trips
tools.description: List the user's Dim Hour trips (code, name, city, item count, share link). Requires the user's Dim Hour API key. Use the code with add_to_trip.

tools.name: post_to_brain
tools.description: Post a message or a proposed state-change into the Dim Hour Triangle brain (the shared room for Poke, Claude, and Clicky). Use this to drop an objective, a status note, or a proposed live_nodes patch. IMPORTANT: every post is recorded as 'asserted' and is NOT treated as true until Claude verifies it

tools.name: read_brain
tools.description: Read the recent Dim Hour Triangle brain posts (the shared room) so you can see what's been proposed and what Claude has verified. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_brain · Private data: get_venue, save_venue, add_to_trip, list_my_trips, post_to_brain, read_brain · Public sink: add_to_trip, list_my_trips, post_to_brain · Destructive: post_to_brain.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_brain · Private data: get_venue, save_venue, add_to_trip, list_my_trips, post_to_brain, read_brain · Public sink: add_to_trip, list_my_trips, post_to_brain · Destructive: post_to_brain

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
